name: browser-activity-monitor
description: Test tooling for the Browser Activity Monitor Firefox extension.

scripts.lint:extension: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files "node_modules/**" "coverage/**" "e2e/**" "playwright-report/**" "test-results/**" "tests/**" "web-ext-artifacts/**" ".github/**" package.json package-lock.json playwright.config.js vitest.config.js TESTING.md --warnings-as-errors --no-input --boring
scripts.test:all: npm run lint:extension && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e
